attempts.summary: Created an SSH host certificate authority on node1 (/etc/ssh/ca/ssh_host_ca), used it to sign the existing ed25519 host key into /etc/ssh/ssh_host_ed25519_key-cert.pub with principals node1/10.100.232.10/localhost and 10-year validity, wired it into sshd via `HostCertificate` in sshd_config, and reloaded sshd. Verified end-to-end that an SSH client trusting only the CA (via an `@cert-authority` line in known_hosts, no pinned host key, StrictHostKeyChecking=yes) connects successfully. Performed the mandatory single-node restart: captured baseline boot_id and healthy sshd/cert state, rebooted node1, polled until reachable, confirmed boot_id changed, and re-verified sshd health, the certificate configuration, and CA-trust connectivity post-restart. All temporary test keys/files were removed afterward.
